note:
3569 -> 3565, net of the odoo/service audit round 1.

Four functions moved, and the total is the sum of four attributed deltas:

  odoo/service/_metrics.py::_add_pool_family        124 -> 104  (-20)
  odoo/tools/config.py::_add_advanced_options        98 -> 107   (+9)
  odoo/tools/config.py::_add_multiprocessing_options 92 -> 100   (+8)
  odoo/service/_threaded.py::_listen_thread         100 ->  99   (-1)

The two config.py increases are the two new job-limit options
(--limit-time-worker-job, --limit-time-real-job); those functions are flat lists
of add_option calls, so an option costs its own lines and there is nothing to
factor out. They are paid for by splitting the borrow-wait histogram emitter out
of _add_pool_family, which was the only part of that function emitting a
multi-sample family rather than one metric per table entry, and the only part
whose emission order matters.
